nom: Estée Lauder Advanced Night Cleansing Balm with Lipid Rich Oil-Infusion

avis.titre: YES....My skin has NEVER felt smoother!
avis.texte: This product has turned me into a believer of Estee skincare!

I love how soft and hydrated my face feels after washing with this product. I have noticed less break outs since using this in the last week. I love this so far and I will definitely be purchasing again.

avis.titre: Moisturizing as well as clean your skin
avis.texte: I've used this product for years. It leaves your face clean and well as moisturized.
This is a great cleansing balm. I have used a similar product from a direct competitor, and this is much lighter in a good way. My skin felt very soft after using. As a bonus- it smells great too!

avis.titre: Must have for total make up removal
avis.texte: I love love love this make up removing balm. I was using farmacy make up removing balm cleanser but it seemed to lose its wow factor. This advanced night cleansing balm is the cats meow tho!!! It is ultra luxurious. Can be used on the sensitive of skins and dryest of skins. I have both. I love whole advanced night repair system.

avis.titre: The best for removing stubborn waterproof mascara
avis.texte: I've tried so many makeup removers that still end up leaving racoon eyes! I use this like a pre cleanse before using advanced night cleanser as my skin tends to be oily. Though I'm sure you can use this as your cleanser alone. I just prefer using both.This cleansing balm is the only product that I've found to remove waterproof mascara and it does it easily without irritating my eyes at all. I highly recommend it to everyone!

This beats out all the other cleansing balms I've tried BY FAR! It fits and exceeds all my needs, am & pm. A little goes a long way and the formula is next level.. its like giving my face a hug in the most luxurious way. I recommend this over Elemis every day of the week and twice on Sunday < 3
Awesome product removes everything without drying out the skin.
It did take makeup off but I felt like it left a film. I almost felt like I needed to wash my face with something else after using. I was not a fan of having to scoop out of tub with my fingers.

This is the best Eye maker remover I've ever used! I've had Lasik eye surgery, so I'm very particular about what I used to remove mascara and eyeliner. I was skeptical about trying this, but I absolutely love it!! Estée Lauder, please never stop making this product!!
Love this cleaning balm. A little goes a long way and is very gentle why completely dissolving all my makeup. This is my go to cleansing balm.
I'm thrilled with this makeup remover. It removes everything without a trace! It has a very gentle texture and a pleasant, light scent. It's very economical to use.
Leaves my skins super hydrated and smells amazing. Well worth the price!

This is the best face cleaner I've used. I have roseacea/sensitive skin. This feels so good! It starts out like an oily feel- similar to Zero, but better!- add water, it foams up. My skin feels so smooth and clean after use! Will purchase again for sure!

avis.titre: Yes, I would buy this product again!
avis.texte: My skin is a bit on the sensitive side and regular makeup remover wipes gave me tiny bumps in the eye area. This product was recommended by an Estée Lauder consultant that was at Ulta while I was there. I've been using it for about 2 weeks now and I love it. Takes off all my foundation (EL Double Wear) with ease, and all other makeup as well. I put it on like a cream then splash warm water on it and continue to rub my face, it looks like milk. I then use a wet, soft makeup removal cloth to completely remove it. I follow it up with my Clinique Clarifying Lotion #3 to remove any residue. It makes my skin feel so soft! And no breakouts of any kind! It is pricey, so I will use rewards points or sales to repurchase, but it only takes a small amount so it should last for months.

avis.titre: I would not buy this product again
avis.texte: This product was recommended to me for removing hard-to remove eye liner and mascara. Not only was it no better than other makeup removers, it burned my eyes (even though they were closed) and the burning lasted quite a while. I had to stop using it and I will be returning it.
I tried this cleansing balm and it's true!! It melts your makeup right off with little effort leasing your skin soft and clean. Try it, you will be be disappointed.
Excellent cleanser, easy to remove make up. I have been continuously purchasing it for 3 years.
This is by far my favorite cleansing balm. It does not irritate my VERY sensitive eyes, gets all my makeup off, and leaves my skin so smooth.
I was given a sample when looking for a cleanser for drier skin. I'm on my second jar! My skin feels clean and supple-a nice palette for makeup.

This product does well for a first oil-based cleanse to help work out sebaceous filaments and blackheads. I absolutely recommend following up with the Geleé or a foaming cleanser like in the Korean double cleansing method. It was fairly drying to my admittedly dry skin after rinsing without the moisturizing Geleé cleanse. The most heartbreaking aspect of this product though is the sad, cheap plastic packaging. Why!?? The rest of the Advanced Night line has such gorgeous, luxurious glass containers.
Have found it effectively removes make up without drying my already drier skin
I love this product! Removes all makeup and dont have issues with mascara it's all gone.
I prefer the Banila Co. Clean It Zero over this product. It does a better job at removing mascara and eyeliner. The pink version also doesn't have a strong fragrance like this one.

I like this product, but it is so different than what I am use to. Having my cleanser in balm form takes some getting use to. It does remove the makeup, and I have no complaints, just very different than what I'm use to. I do wonder if this is going to last as long as a gel/lotion cleanser.

This a smooth, gentle cleanser with a very light fragrance. Does a great job removing makeup and rinses easily with warm water. My eyes are really sensitive so I have to be really careful what I use on and around my eyes, but I have no issues with this product.

I bought this first because I wanted something to take off mascara that wasn't liquid when I travel. (You can scoop up a little and put into a light weight plastic travel jar.) I now use it every night to take off everything. It removes eye makeup without tugging. It seems to change consistancy as I add water while massageing it around my face. It does not leave my skin feeling greasy, I might even wash my face with another gentle cleanser to boot or use a toner product after just incase I miss any makeup because I wear alot.
This cleansing balm is so good, it really does clean and makes my skin feel so soft, very nourishing.

avis.titre: "Gentle, Effective, and Perfect for Sensitive Eyes!"
avis.texte: I absolutely love the Estée Lauder Advanced Night Cleansing Balm with Lipid-Rich Oil Infusion. My eyelids are incredibly sensitive, and it's been a challenge to find a makeup remover that actually works without irritating my skin or stinging my eyes. This balm not only removes my makeup seamlessly, but it also melts it away without any discomfort or burning. It's gentle yet effective, and I love how soft and hydrated my skin feels afterward. Plus, it takes off even the most stubborn waterproof makeup with ease, all without needing to rub harshly. Highly recommend it for anyone with sensitive skin looking for a luxurious, soothing cleanser!
I love this product! It makes my skin glow and leaves it feeling soft and moistured.
I love this product. It cleans the sunscreen off very thoroughly, at first I thought it would make my face greasy but it doesn't, it's smooth and clean, I love it.

Thank you for the opportunity to review the Advanced Night Cleansing Balm. I have been an Estee Lauder skin care and cosmetic consumer for many decades as was my mother. On rare occasions I took advantage of opportunities to try other brands which ultimately convinced me that I already had the best. I use the Advanced Night Cleansing Balm to wash my face in the morning and sometimes for longer periods of time as a mask. It makes my skin feel soothed, comforted and moisturized. I am 72 and no one believes my age as I learned the importance of "plumping" products such as this is one. Thank you Estee Lauder!
Excellent texture; just glides on face and feels moisturizing and removes everything on your face. My face doesn't feel dry after cleansing.
I was pleasantly surprised with this product. It did remove mascara and was easy to apply and rinse off. It left my face lightly moisturized, and I'm very glad I decided to try it.
This is the only product that actually works for taking off ALL of my makeup
Perfect oil balm never used an oily feeling product but I actually love it! You know where it is by feel while rinsing off and the end result on my face is magical
This makes my skin better but somehow without leaving Anything behind. Removes DoubleWear foundation and concealer with ease.
I love this product. I've integrated it into my nightly routine. I love how moisturizing it is!!!

I've been using Estee Lauder since I was 18, I'm now 69….. love all their products and this is one that I cannot do without! My skin is very sensitive and dry. It takes a small amount to cleanse. Sometimes I let it sit on my face for 5-10 minutes before removing. For my dry skin, it's so much better than a soap-based cleanser.

I've used this cleansing balm nightly for a few weeks now. It cleanses thoroughly, and even removes my (sometimes) generous mascara. It also rinses thoroughly. So glad I tried this - it leaves my aging skin with a level of softness and moisture I don't get with other products.

This product does a great job of breaking down my makeup/sunscreen prior to cleansing my skin. It washes away without the normal greasy feeling of other cleansing balms. Each application requires a small amount so the product should last forever!

FOR YEARS, I USED A DIFFERENT BRAND OF CLEANSING BALM, I WAS NOT SURE ABOUT TRYING THIS BALM BECAUSE IT IS PRICEY. NOW I CAN SAY THAT IT WORTH EACH AND EVERY PENNY! SMELL IS AWESOME. I WOULD HAVE RECOMMEND TO ADD A TINY SPATULA APART FROM THAT, THIS BALM IS A MUST HAVE!

I recently made this purchase and it has not disappointed me at all. Usually to take off my makeup I go in with a make up remover wipe and then wash my face with cleanser and still find makeup in my skin. This product literally melts everything off of my skin. Since it's infused with skin care it leaves my skin feeling so good after. Another really good balm is the Tatcha indigo cleansing bomb but it has nothing on this!!!

This is the most expensive cleansing balm I own and its honestly worth the price. It feels luxurious and almost creamy. Melts immediately and doesnt require a lot of rubbing at all. Removes all makeup including waterproof mascara. I have very dry, sensitive skin and this doesnt irritate me at all. A little goes a long way and if I use too much it can make my eyes slightly blurry for a few minutes.

avis.titre: Yes, oil is a great cleaner.
avis.texte: Removes eye make-up. I glow. Switching from a soap-type cleanser to an oil can be odd until you try it. My skin is so soft. It is a great base for Night Repair Serum and your moisturizer. You need just traces of both to look amazing. I wake up looking refreshed, even on a restless night's sleep. My first one lasted 6 months. Half a year! I plop a blob in an old sample container, and it weighs nothing for flying.

Maybe it is because I'm a first time balm user but I was disappointed with how my skin felt after using. It does remove make-up like stated and it does not sting my eyes which is a bonus, but I didn't get the silky feel I am used to from the Soft Clean. So I have ordered more Soft Clean and will continue to use the balm at night to remove make-up and the Soft Clean in the morning to start my day with great feeling skin.

Been using ANR Cleansing Balm for a long time and nothing beats it when it comes to removing my makeup (Double Wear everything), my skin clean without dryness nor irritation, face is soft, supple and hydrated. Also helps in keeping my rare skin disease, prurigo nodularis in check from flare ups. All in one use.

at first I was leery~ but it is wonderful ~ I use dry hands massage a small amount all over my face then rinse with warm water.. at first I thought it would leave my face greasy but far from it, smooth, clean & loving it

I fell in love with this cleansing balm the second I put it on my face. I honestly can't say what it does, or exactly why I love it so much—I just do. It's incredibly soothing, does a beautiful job cleansing, and feels great on the skin!

I have been using the ANR Cleansing Balm for about a week and am absolutely in LOVE! For years I have used another brand's cleansing oil but it always left my eyes irritated. When I saw this cleanser I decided to give it a try since I am a loyal ANR user. It only takes a little bit to completely remove your makeup and cleanse. I love how it goes on as a balm, changes to a milky wash when water added and rinses cleanly leaving my skin feeling soft, moisturized and glowing. This never leaves my sensitive skin feeling stripped, irritated or tight like other cleansers. I hope this sticks around as I have found my holy grail nighttime cleanser!
I love this cleanser. Wish I could afford to buy more. Very nice product.
Leaves skin feeling nice and clean without over drying it is pricey but work it also does last some time highly recommended
I have dry skin and this product is wonderful for removing makeup. Just a small amount does the trick! Love this product!!

I have oily skin all my life. Now in my 70's it has changed texture. When I tried this cleansing Baum right after it was first released, I did not think I would like it. I was so very wrong! I love it. It immediately calms me down as I apply it. It even removes most of my mascara. Then I have a Clarisonic brush (Mia) that I dampen under running warm water and use all over my face. It transforms into a wonderful cleansing foam. It cleans every pore. Can't live without that brush either. Apply, an astringent and then a good serum or moisturizer. Anyway, this is a wonderful product that I hope doesn't get discontinued. Love it!
I use this every night! I'm not sure how I went so long without knowing about this. This gets everything off after a long day. Not only does my face feel cleaner, it IS cleaner. Love this stuff!
I received a sample of this product. I think it really works well. Please note I write the review for the Estee lauder loyalty points.
This clean very clean, use up the skin is not tight, easy to use

I wanted to like this but I have been unsuccessful. I cannot get it out of the jar and onto my face it is Sooo hard that barely anything comes out of the jar and onto my fingers. On the positive side, it has no offensive scent but it just doesn't perform well for me and I am very disappointed because it received so many positive reviews.

I have to say this is hands down, one of the best EL products I have ever used, and it is well worth the price. It is a relatively large container and you barely need any. It works extremely well to remove makeup and the feel it leaves on your skin is other worldly. I was afraid it would be just like any other cleanser but its' truly not like anything I have ever used. My ONLY complaint is about the ingredient Polyethylene. This is a microplastic. I'm highly disappointed it is in this product because all the other ingredients are great. Regardless of what research states about the safety of putting plastic on your skin, I don't buy it. There is no logical way that seems OK. If it could be removed from this product, I'd rate it 10 star! I will use my current container but not sure I'd purchase again for this reason.

avis.titre: Didn't know how much I needed this!
avis.texte: I'm into the Korean 10 step skincare routine so I purchased this cleansing balm as the first step, even though it's targeted for makeup removal. I do not wear any makeup so I cannot attest how easily your makeup will melt, but I can tell you it completely removes my sunscreen & all gunk from my face! Not only does it make my skin sooo soft but it hasn't given me any breakouts. I suffer from cystic acne and have to be very careful with anything I put on my face. Only a small amount is needed and I never feel oily. One star off because it does breakdown my eyelash extensions.
My favorite by far. Leaves my skin smooth and feeling very clean. Great for removing makeup. Easy to use! Will last.

This is amazing! It is a must have and feels extremely hydrating . I use this every pm and usually in the am I use the re nutriv and sometimes the perfectly clean. Among all of the cleansers this is my favorite and I cannot live without it.
I really like this cleanser. Gets my face very clean and doesn't feel greasy. A little goes a long way!
It works like a dream. It takes all my makeup off and does not tug on my eyes. Glides perfectly across and removes everything. Sadly, the price is so high compared to the amount of product.

This is my first time trying this, and I love it. I actually use it with my Facial Cleaning Brush, and it works great. Also. leaves your skin so soft after. You don't much, so it will last you a long time.
My skin has never been softer since I started using this cleanser. I love the mild scent and how clean my face feels afterward.

This balm is excellent for removing makeup. It feels delicately soft while applying it on the skin and the results are a very clean, smooth and soft skin. Off course, it's good to apply a nice moisturizer afterwards.
I love this balm. Oh wow it's so creamy and my skin feels amazing after using it. I'm new to this brand and I'm loving it !! It's a relaxing time using this balm.
This product is so awesome. It leaves my skin feeling so clean and soft. I would recommend this product.
I have always wanted to buy a cleansing cream until I received the product last time. I tried this cleansing cream. It is very mild and non-irritating, and it cleans my face very clean
I tried this for the first time late last year. I absolutely love the feel of the cleanser. It leaves my skin clean and hydrated, but not oily. Highly recommend.
You need to slowly move your fingers in a circular motion and you don't need much. I use it at night with my other cleanser and my only cleanser in the morning
I used a lot of cleanser but this cleansing balm is the best I ever owned, just use a little bit for a long way. overall I am very happy with this product, I would recommend this to my friends.
This is the best product I have used for removing eyelash adhesive. Highly recommend.

This is the best cleansing product I have ever used. It takes off makeup completely, lasts a long time and you only need a little bit. Your face feels smooth and soft. I just bought another one…can't imagine being without it.
I usually love Estee Lauder products, but this was a complete let down. I used so much of the product and none of my makeup came off. I had to use another product to get it off.

I have combination skin, T zone. My skin gets dry during winter months, especially on my cheeks. This cleanser is perfect for my skin. It melts on your hand, when you use a little water, and leaves your skin soft and not dry and stripped. I have been using this all week and noticed that it isn't dry and my face feels "normal", soft. Even plump.

Have used this product for a few weeks now and love it. Emulsified on skin right away and add a little warm water to create a bit of a lather… then remove with a warm wash cloth. I have combination skin … 72 years old.

My only regret is not buying this sooner. This magical balm melts into your skin leaving it clean, soft and feeling hydrated. My skin looks and feels healthier. A very little goes a very long way! I use less than a dime sized amount and massage it into my skin for about 2 minutes. It removes all traces of my foundation. I'm not sure why some reviews say it takes a lot of the product, as it basically liquifies when it touches your skin.
I use in winter. Skin feels soft not weathered in cold air. Simple for travel.
I found this balm can remove blackhead. Gentlely message it on your nose for 3-5 minutes and the result is satisfactory.

I love this cleansing balm! My skin tends to be a bit on the dry side (plus living in the desert doesn't help!). This balm cleanses my skin thoroughly and is moisturizing and gentle. It rinses off fully for nice, soft, and clean skin!

I actually really love this balm, it takes my makeup off quickly, doesn't burn my eyes, and I never get that cloudy eye thing after I use it… The ONLY downside that I've seemed to have is that the packaging makes it sooo hard to open the product! I have no idea why and it is so frustrating because I just want to be able to open it right away and get my makeup off but I spend like 10 minutes trying to get the lid off most times because it gets stuck LOL Other then that tho, if it didn't have this weird lid issue it would be 5 stars! This product is wonderful and makes my skin feel amazingggg!

This cleansing balm is not irritating to the eyes at all which is excellent (although on a bit of oily side). However, it does take a bit of patience and several repeat steps to truly remove all your makeup off completely.

This balm was a true surprise for me in the best way! My skin is extremely sensitive and I am cautious when trying something new. This is the absolute best cleaner I have ever used! It removes all of my make up with very little effort and leaves my skin soft and spotlessly clean! I highly recommend this product!!
I love everything about this cleanser except the price. It cleans my skin, doesn't leave a film and doesn't dry my skin out. My face has a healthy glow.
It's very gentle and easy to remove makeup. I like its appearance. It's very simple.

This is the best way for me to remove my makeup. It is gentle on my not so young skin and even removes waterproof eye makeup. I am very sensitive to most cleansers. In fact,only Estee Lauder can be counted on to not irritate my skin. My skin is neither greasy nor tight after using this. I only gave it a 4 star because it is expensive and I seem to go through it rapidly.

In the past I had oily skin but as I have aged it's become a combination. I have used the Advance Night Micro Cleaning Balm since it first came out. Since then, I have used nothing else. Makeup melts off my face, including eye makeup. My face feels and looks clean and glowing. I use a sonicare brush with the Balm. Great combination!

When I went to an Estée Lauder counter to buy makeup the assistant used this first to wipe off the makeup I had on. I fell in love with it and have used it ever since. It smells wonderful and removes my makeup easily without me having to scrub my skin. I bought some for my 25 year old daughter and she has also fallen in love with it.
This gets off my toughest mascara! And it doesn't burn my eyes like other products do! I have dry sensitive skin and it doesn't bother it either!

I love everything about this cleansing balm - completely removes make up without any oily residue. I love the way my skin feels after cleansing not stripped - smells great too - a very light lavender fragrance. On some night I do a 'double cleanse' and follow with the Advanced Night Micro Cleansing Foam.
My skin feel so silky after cleansing . I am seeing such a improvement of makeup removal. Will always have this on hand .
I now have to return that item and one other as my skin got so red that it took 3 days to get it to not be as red.

I love this micro cleansing balm, it is hassles free, mess free for me personally and so easy to apply as well as remove. I tell ya, I have caked on make up sometimes, layers of foundation, powder, bronze high lighter for my cheeks and blush. Just apply the balm to my face at first felt like, will this really work? It did, it just wiped all off, using my wash cloth and following online directions of how to use this. No residue, my face felt soft and fresh. Good news was next day, no breaks outs and no feeling oily residue on my face from the balm. I did apply a Estee Lauder moisturizer to follow the balm to help prevent breakouts for my dry to oily combination skin. I have very sensitive skin and I have to make sure to clean my face daily especially after wearing make up. Even on the days that I do not have cakes on make up, wither I use a powder on my face with blush and no foundation, this balm takes it right off. I do not think I can ever go back to doing things the old way ever again. This micro balm has spoiled me.

The way my skin feels as I am working the balm into my skin is wonderful. The fact that I don't need a separate makeup remover is useful. There is no stinging or tightness after soaping up and rinsing off. I noticed a change for the better in my skin after the first use. Love love love!

This cleanser is truly amazing and I absolutely love it! It is so silky feeling. It starts like a solid and as you massage it on your face it emulsifiers to remove all of your makeup! then add a little water to continue cleansing your face, and rinse. I love the smell, feel, and most of all how well it works to remove all the makeup off of my face.
I like how this works, feels smooth, and clean my make-up really good but sometimes I feel like I need to wash my nose with something else to better clean my pores.

For several months I was getting breakouts. I decided that the correct cleanser was what was needed. After starting with this I have not had the breakout problem. It smells great especially in the evening because of the lavender. Physical sunscreen is the best (EL Perfectionist is a good one) and this takes it off, and most makeup needs something like this. I use some Perfectly Clean foam purifying cleanser after the balm. In the A.M. I use just a little Perfectly Clean foam purifying cleanser in the t-zone.
This is the BEST make up remover. I have dry and very sensitive skin. It takes off all your make up, including mascara, and leaves no residue. I will never use anything else again!!

This product is very effective at removing makeup. I am pleased with the feel of the product and how it cleanses the skin surface. The product is exceptional in usage and preps your facial skin for the Advanced Night Micro Cleansing Foam.

This cleanser is one of the best I have used. It removes both makeup and dirt with ease, very gentle to skin, but effective, even removes Doublewear Makeup, which we all know is there to stay put, but this gently washes it away, I love it.
This cleansing balm feels very smooth. After rinsing it with water it makes my skin very bright and moist. It also helps with redness and acnes.
Love the way it goes on and you don't need much of it at all I am really glad that I tried it

I was introduced to this balm a few years ago and once I tried it I haven't used another since. This balm feels so nice as I gently massage it into my skin and I actually look forward to this daily "self treatment!" It removes every bit of makeup, including my waterproof liquid eyeliner, mascara, and Double-Wear liquid foundation...it is the only cleanser for me!
Used another product before sales girl recommended this I love it

I use it nightly! My skin feels soft and refreshed. I notice some lightening of brown spots and brightening of my complexion.I was not disappointed in the results after about 7 days of use. I recommend trying this product.

The cleansing balm is perfect for breaking the seal of my EL foundation, without breaking down my very sensitive skin. A small amount does the job. The product quickly melts down and provides a calming treatment to my skin. I highly recommend.
This makeup remover can remove the foundation fluid and makeup powder without residue. I like it so much
